entries.name: Ben Skowronek
entries.summary: The Steelers have ruled Skowronek (calf) out for Sunday's matchup against the Saints, Mike DeFabo of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Case Keenum
entries.summary: Keenum (coach's decision) is inactive but will operate as the Bears' emergency third quarterback for Thursday night's matchup against the Patriots.

entries.name: Deebo Samuel Sr.
entries.summary: Samuel (hamstring) is not expected to practice Wednesday, Cam Inman of Bay Area News Group reports.

entries.name: Kyle Monangai
entries.summary: inactive

entries.name: Luke Musgrave
entries.summary: Packers head coach Matt Lafleur said Thursday it's "tough to say" whether Musgrave (neck) plays this season, Weston Hodkiewicz of the Packers' official site reports.

entries.name: Terry McLaurin
entries.summary: Commanders head coach Dan Quinn announced Monday that McLaurin has been diagnosed with a torn patellar tendon in his left knee following an MRI and will miss the rest of the season.

entries.name: David Montgomery
entries.summary: Montgomery (groin) will not play Sunday against the Giants, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.

entries.name: Emeka Egbuka
entries.summary: Egbuka (concussion) is doubtful for Sunday's game against the Panthers, Greg Auman of Fox Sports reports.

entries.name: Marcus Mariota
entries.summary: doubtful

entries.name: Adonai Mitchell
entries.summary: Jets coach Aaron Glenn said Friday that Mitchell (finger) will play Sunday against the Dolphins, Brian Costello of the New York Post reports.

entries.name: Anthony Gould
entries.summary: Gould (concussion) did not practice Wednesday or Thursday.

entries.name: Ashton Dulin
entries.summary: Dulin (hamstring) was a limited participant in practice Thursday.

entries.name: Bo Melton
entries.summary: Melton (back) did not participate in practice Thursday, Weston Hodkiewicz of the Packers' official site reports.

entries.name: Breece Hall
entries.summary: Hall (quadriceps) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Dolphins, Brian Costello of the New York Post reports.

entries.name: Brenen Thompson
entries.summary: Thompson (quadriceps) was active but didn't play any snaps Sunday in the Chargers' 22-6 loss to the Chiefs.

entries.name: Brevin Jordan
entries.summary: Jordan was limited in practice Thursday due to a foot issue.

entries.name: Brian Robinson Jr.
entries.summary: Robinson (hamstring) didn't practice Thursday, Marc Raimondi of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Bucky Irving
entries.summary: Irving (illness) is practicing Friday, Pewter Report reports.

entries.name: Caleb Douglas
entries.summary: Dolphins coach Jeff Hafley said Friday that Douglas (ankle) will play Sunday against the Jets, C. Isaiah Smalls II of the Miami Herald reports.

entries.name: Calvin Ridley
entries.summary: Ridley (hip) will not practice Friday and is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against Cleveland, Turron Davenport of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Carson Beck
entries.summary: Beck (back) did not participate at practice Thursday, Darren Urban of the Cardinals' official site reports.

entries.name: Chris Manhertz
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Christian Watson
entries.summary: Watson (ankle) practiced in a limited fashion Thursday, Rob Demovsky of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Cole Kmet
entries.summary: Kmet is believed to have suffered a serious right knee injury in Thursday night's win over the Patriots, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

entries.name: Dallas Goedert
entries.summary: Goedert (knee) was held out of Thursday's practice.

entries.name: Dalton Schultz
entries.summary: Schultz (quadriceps) was a limited participant at Thursday's practice.

entries.name: Denzel Boston
entries.summary: Boston (foot) remained limited at Thursday's practice.

entries.name: DeVonta Smith
entries.summary: Smith (hamstring) didn't practice Thursday.

entries.name: DJ Moore
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Dontayvion Wicks
entries.summary: Wicks (ankle) was a non-participant at Thursday's practice.

entries.name: Drew Lock
entries.summary: Lock (elbow) was a limited practice participant Thursday, John Boyle of the Seahawks' official site reports.

entries.name: George Pickens
entries.summary: Pickens was a limited practice participant Thursday due to a shoulder injury, Tommy Yarrish of the Cowboys' official site reports.

entries.name: Jaylen Waddle
entries.summary: Waddle (chest) remained a limited participant in Thursday's practice.

entries.name: Jaylen Wright
entries.summary: Dolphins coach Jeff Hafley said Friday that Wright (foot) will play in Sunday's game against the Jets, Barry Jackson of the Miami Herald reports.

entries.name: Jeremiyah Love
entries.summary: Love (ankle) remained sidelined at Thursday's practice, Darren Urban of the Cardinals' official site reports.

entries.name: KaVontae Turpin
entries.summary: Turpin (ribs) did not participate at practice Thursday, Tommy Yarrish of the Cowboys' official site reports.

entries.name: KC Concepcion
entries.summary: Concepcion (calf/quadriceps) was a limited participant in Thursday's practice.

entries.name: Kene Nwangwu
entries.summary: Nwangwu (knee) did not participate at practice Thursday.

entries.name: Ladd McConkey
entries.summary: McConkey won't return to Sunday's game at Kansas City due to a concussion.

entries.name: Lamar Jackson
entries.summary: Jackson (ankle) is practicing Friday, Brian Wacker of The Baltimore Sun reports.

entries.name: Matthew Golden
entries.summary: Golden (shoulder) was limited at Thursday's practice, Rob Demovsky of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Mike Evans
entries.summary: Evans (ribs/Achilles) didn't practice Thursday, Nick Wagoner of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Mike Washington Jr.
entries.summary: Washington (foot/back) downgraded to DNP on Thursday, Anthony Galaviz of The Fresno Bee reports.

entries.name: Olamide Zaccheaus
entries.summary: Zaccheaus (shoulder) was a limited practice participant Thursday, Tori McElhaney of the Falcons' official site reports.

entries.name: Puka Nacua
entries.summary: The calf injury Nacua sustained Thursday is believed to be "more minor than anything else" and "not significant," Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

entries.name: Quinshon Judkins
entries.summary: Judkins (ankle) remained a limited participant at Thursday's practice, Chris Easterling of the Akron Beacon Journal reports.

entries.name: Rashee Rice
entries.summary: Rice (hamstring/knee) did not practice Thursday.

entries.name: Rico Dowdle
entries.summary: Dowdle (knee) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Saints in Paris, Alan Saunders of SteelersNow.com reports.

entries.name: Saquon Barkley
entries.summary: Barkley (hamstring) practiced in a limited capacity Thursday.

entries.name: Savion Williams
entries.summary: Williams (ankle) was listed as limited at Thursday's practice, Rob Demovsky of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: T.J. Hockenson
entries.summary: Hockenson (concussion) was listed as a full participant Thursday.

entries.name: Theo Johnson
entries.summary: Johnson (neck) was a limited participant at practice Thursday.

entries.name: Travis Kelce
entries.summary: Kelce (ankle) was listed as a limited participant in Thursday's practice.

entries.name: Tre' Harris
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Tyler Badie
entries.summary: Badie (thumb) did not participate at practice Thursday, Parker Gabriel of The Denver Post reports.

entries.name: Tyler Warren
entries.summary: Warren (groin) was not practicing Friday, Nathan Brown of The Indianapolis Star reports.

entries.name: Will Kacmarek
entries.summary: Kacmarek (hamstring) was limited in Thursday's practice, but he said he expects to play Sunday versus the Jets, Joe Schad of The Palm Beach Post reports.

entries.name: Zach Charbonnet
entries.summary: Charbonnet (knee) practiced fully Thursday, John Boyle of the Seahawks' official site reports.

entries.name: Alec Pierce
entries.summary: Colts head coach Shane Steichen said Monday that Pierce (heel) won't have his 21-day practice window opened in Week 7, Nathan Brown of The Indianapolis Star reports.

entries.name: Beaux Collins
entries.summary: The Falcons designated Collins (hip) to return from IR on Thursday, per the NFL's transaction log.

entries.name: Carter Runyon
entries.summary: Runyon (foot) was a full participant in practice Wednesday.

entries.name: Christian Kirk
entries.summary: Kirk (calf) was a full practice participant Thursday, Nick Wagoner of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Davante Adams
entries.summary: Adams (hamstring) was placed on injured reserve Tuesday, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

entries.name: Dont'e Thornton Jr.
entries.summary: Thornton (hamstring) was a full participant at practice Wednesday.

entries.name: Dylan Sampson
entries.summary: Sampson (knee) was a limited participant in Thursday's practice.

entries.name: Eli Stowers
entries.summary: Stowers (quadriceps) was a full participant at the Eagles' practice Thursday.

entries.name: Elijah Arroyo
entries.summary: Arroyo (shoulder) was placed on injured reserve Thursday, and Adam Schefter of ESPN reports that Arroyo will miss the remainder of the season.

entries.name: Grant Calcaterra
entries.summary: Calcaterra (back) was a full participant at the Eagles' practice Thursday.

entries.name: Jadarian Price
entries.summary: Head coach Mike Macdonald said Friday that Price "should be looking at a sooner rather than later return after" the Seahawks' next game in Week 7, Brady Henderson of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Jalen Hurts
entries.summary: Hurts (calf) is expected to be held out of football activities for multiple months and miss the rest of the season after new imaging over the weekend revealed several blood clots in his lungs, Tom Pelissero of Netflix reports.

entries.name: Jaylin Lane
entries.summary: Lane underwent surgery Oct. 9 to repair his fractured and dislocated ankle, and he is expected to be cleared for activities before OTAs, Tashan Reed of The Washington Post reports.

entries.name: Jonah Coleman
entries.summary: Coleman (ankle) was a full participant in Thursday's practice.

entries.name: Jonathon Brooks
entries.summary: Brooks (core) was seen jogging at practice Thursday, Sheena Quick of Fox Sports Radio 1340 reports.

entries.name: Jordan Mason
entries.summary: Mason (thumb) practiced fully Thursday.

entries.name: Jordyn Tyson
entries.summary: Saints general manager Mickey Loomis said Tuesday that Tyson (hamstring) is "getting closer" but won't practice this week, Ross Jackson of WWL Louisiana reports.

entries.name: Josh Oliver
entries.summary: The Vikings placed Oliver (biceps) on injured reserve Tuesday, Craig Peters of the team's official site reports.

entries.name: Romeo Doubs
entries.summary: Doubs (shoulder) is hopeful to return after the Patriots' Week 11 bye and isn't expected to face a long-term absence, Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Skyy Moore
entries.summary: The Packers placed Moore (ankle) on injured reserve Saturday.

entries.name: Tank Dell
entries.summary: Texans head coach DeMeco Ryans said Monday that Dell (knee) is on track to return from injured reserve to make his season debut in Week 7 versus the Giants, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.

entries.name: Tanner Hudson
entries.summary: Hudson (pectoral) was placed on injured reserve by the Bengals on Monday.

entries.name: Terrance Ferguson
entries.summary: Ferguson (ankle), who is eligible to come off injured reserve next week, isn't expected to be ready at that time, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

entries.name: Tom Kennedy
entries.summary: The Lions placed Kennedy (knee) on injured reserve Friday.

entries.name: Tyquan Thornton
entries.summary: The Chiefs placed Thornton (ankle) on injured reserve Tuesday.
